as_told.title: Charles Fort's Book of the Damned: we are property

plain: Humans are said to be the property of some other, hidden power, owned the way Britain held India under the Raj, its period of colonial rule there. The idea goes back to the writer Charles Fort, a collector of strange and unexplained reports. The philosopher Jason Jorjani tells it in a 2025 episode. He says Fort was "the first person to theorize about this with regard to the UFO phenomenon", back in the 1920s, and Jorjani is the one who uses the comparison with British India. If true, it would mean that humanity is run by something it cannot see. Salvatore Pais, a Navy scientist who holds patents on unusual craft designs, points to the same idea in another 2025 episode. He quotes Fort's line, "I believe we are property", and tells listeners to "read that book". The book is Fort's The Book of the Damned, published in 1919. Pais does not mention the Raj.
